CoWork Projects/Founders Future Prompts/Add Rules to Git/SPEC_Taxo_IdSpace_And_Tenant_Scope_Gates.md (founder-approved; G2 entries added 2026-08-13, hierarchy_level for org_purpose_category_idfr/org_mission_category_idfr corrected from spec's 'domain' to 'leaf' per live-code cross-check; org_goal_category_idfr deliberately excluded pending founder clarification)

External critic follow-up on .github#32 (2026-08-13, this PR): the merged contract's hierarchy_level='leaf' for org_purpose_category_idfr / org_mission_category_idfr was sourced from explore-organization.sql.ts and discover.sql.v1.ts's read-JOIN predicates -- the exact predicates PR #1130 (service_orbit_orgs, merged 25 minutes after #32) removed on the finding that 'leaf' was WRONG there. Corrected to 'domain' per the live write/validate reference paths (org_purpus_category.sql.ts:addPredefinedPurposeCategory, org_mission_category.validator.ts:validateMissionCetegoryId), which reject any id that is not hierarchy_level='domain'. checker.py also fixed: _closest() was block-scoped only, so a level literal from a NEIGHBOURING join in the same backtick block (e.g. a size/type join) could be misattributed to a column with no level literal of its own -- narrowed to the single JOIN...ON clause.

org_goal_category_idfr.source: Moved out of needs_founder_decision 2026-08-13 (this follow-up). org_goal_category.validator.ts filters type='match_goals' AND hierarchy_level='domain' when resolving this column -- the same reference-write-path shape as org_purpus_category.sql.ts and org_mission_category.validator.ts. discover.sql.ts's getDiscoverOrgByMissionPurpose resolves the same concept with no level filter at all (read-side, does not contradict a write-side assertion). org_n.org_goal.org_goal_category_idfr is a separate, out-of-scope column: a plain FK to a per-tenant org_goal_category table, not taxo.master.
